scope: Only recovered original-provider ZIP custody directory and historical FCP decoded-log directory. Existing custody receipts preserved; scientific scope and original artifact counts unchanged. File metadata checked against checkpoint and applicable receipt pins; historical SHA256/CRC inherited, not freshly replayed. No blanket claim of absence of dynamic code dependencies.
retrieval: Resolve old full path in records; retrieve exact bytes by checkpoint commit and unchanged original path. Verify Git blob and size; for ZIPs check recorded SHA256 and ZIP CRC before use. Never interpret decoded logs as original ZIPs. Restore individual files in a scratch checkout if a legacy verifier requires local paths, never re-add whole vault to main merely for convenience.
